Sensor value used as the internal temperature.

column15: 0 = Off (all outputs off); 1 = Idle (internal blower on); 2 = Cooling (blowers and compressor on); 3 = Heating (internal blower and heater on); 4 = Testing

column7: 1 = alarm active. Some bits apply only to certain controller types.
column15: bit 0 = High internal temperature; bit 1 = Low internal temperature; bit 2 = Compressor failure (pressure pipe algorithm); bit 3 = Faulty ambient sensor; bit 4 = Faulty auxiliary sensor; bit 5 = Faulty icing sensor (S1); bit 6 = Faulty internal temperature sensor; bit 7 = Carel/inverter communication failure; bit 8 = Phase failure (3-phase units); bit 9 = Alarm compressor; bit 10 = Alarm ambient blower; bit 11 = Alarm internal blower; bit 12 = Warning compressor; bit 13 = Warning ambient blower; bit 14 = Warning internal blower; bit 15 = Alarm delta outlet-inlet temperature
bit 0 = Heater; bit 1 = Internal blower; bit 2 = Ambient blower; bit 3 = Compressor
bit 0 = Door contact 1; bit 1 = Door contact 2; bit 2 = Door contact 3
